content: Converge the repository expert-skill design review: correct protocol and semantic guidance, add the missing ecosystem-neutral runtime/contracts owner, make package and routing expectations machine-checkable, and leave reproducible validation and durable handoff records.

Clarify D0008 without weakening it: Linux scan may expose an unbound pci_dev at device_add, while matching remains disabled until the kernel-staged MetaFlux override is ready; only successful MetaFlux bind may commit registry ONLINE, and vendor-driver matching remains forbidden.

Add runtime-contracts-registry as the sole expert owner for ecosystem-neutral registry views, client negotiation, shared layouts, backend C ABI, and canonical cross-layer schema generation; compatibility, target, transport, presentation, and lifecycle skills retain their layer-local decisions.

Separate static skill evidence from behavioral routing evidence: repository gates validate package metadata and the structured bilingual corpus, while tools/check-skill-routing.py scores only explicitly captured model/host/repetition observations.

The M0100 review separated PTX source meaning and its oracle from MLIR conversion mechanics and from CPU/Vulkan target lowering, runtime behavior, and performance evidence; the affected skill descriptions, references, and plan routes now use those owners consistently.

The transport and lifecycle review separated Linux cdev/UAPI lifetime, vfio-user wire/DMA behavior, PCI presentation, and generation/epoch lifecycle authority. D0008 now distinguishes Linux scan visibility from successful MetaFlux driver binding without permitting vendor-driver matching.

The repository validator now enforces exact skill catalog coverage, domain package section order, canonical agents/openai.yaml metadata, and Codex discovery. The structured bilingual routing corpus covers 11 domain skills with 68 cases, including 13 compositions, and its separate scorer validates captured observation metadata and source digests.

Independent spot review of representative single-skill, near-miss, and composition prompts agreed with the revised ownership routes. This is supporting review only; no complete 68-case, three-repetition behavioral observation file was claimed.

Cross-domain consistency review found and reconciled stale ownership phrases across runtime, compatibility, transport, lifecycle, and Vulkan guidance; the final active sources use one owner for each semantic, mechanism, target, transport, presentation, and lifecycle decision.

Validator and build-gate review confirmed the routing checker and its 23-case self-test are included in CTest and the Nix Agent-record fileset, while generated Python bytecode is excluded from the source closure.

Adversarial runtime-gate review converged W0102 and M0120 lifecycle guidance on never-reused view identity, FIFO range reserve/retire records, independent admission closure, tagged publication and telemetry records, proven-death-only raw-write helping, reserved terminal records, and whole-mapping quarantine for a possibly live timed-out writer.

Final verification passed: 16/16 Codex skill packages, Agent records plus 52 self-tests, the 11-skill 68-case routing corpus plus 23/23 routing self-tests, CMake configure, CTest 18/18, git diff whitespace checks, and nix flake check path:. -L.

Content commit 497a58fb8d54da5ea569bb894736de98c58d8fb8 converges expert skill contracts, cross-skill routing, runtime/lifecycle planning invariants, validators, and build gates without promoting queued product work to implemented or release-ready status.
